local function corner(o, r)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)
    c.Parent = o
    return c
end

local function stroke(o, col, th, tr)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = col
    s.Thickness = th or 1
    s.Transparency = tr or 0.2
    s.Parent = o
    return s
end

local function tween(obj, props, t)
    TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t or 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

-- ===== BACKGROUNDS =====
local BG_B64 = ""

local function b64decode(data)
    local b = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    data = data:gsub("[^"..b.."=]", "")
    return (data:gsub(".", function(x)
        if x == "=" then return "" end
        local r, f = "", (b:find(x, 1, true) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i-1) > 0 and "1" or "0") end
        return r
    end):gsub("%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?", function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return "" end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == "1" and 2^(8-i) or 0) end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

local function loadEmbeddedBg()
    local getter = getcustomasset or getsynasset
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getter) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local ok, asset = pcall(function()
        writefile("ViolettePacket_BG.jpg", b64decode(BG_B64))
        return getter("ViolettePacket_BG.jpg")
    end)
    if ok and asset and asset ~= "" then return asset end
    return nil
end

local function applyBackground(i)
    i = tonumber(i) or 1
    if not BACKGROUNDS[i] then i = 1 end
    local bg = BACKGROUNDS[i]
    currentBg = i
    if bg.kind == "image" and (bg.asset or bgImageAsset) then
        MainBg.Image = bg.asset or bgImageAsset
        MainBg.Visible = true
        Main.BackgroundColor3 = BG_BLACK
        MainGrad.Color = DEFAULT_GRAD
    elseif bg.kind == "gradient" then
        MainBg.Visible = false
        Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        MainGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, bg.c1),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, bg.c2),
        }
    else
        MainBg.Visible = false
        Main.BackgroundColor3 = BG_BLACK
        MainGrad.Color = DEFAULT_GRAD
    end
    if paintThumbs then paintThumbs() end
end

local lagging        = false

local intensity      = 16000
local isCollapsed    = false

local clickLock      = false

-- Auto Steal (Violette logic)
local Steal = {
    AutoStealEnabled = false,
    StealRadius      = 65,
    StealDuration    = 1.2,
    Data             = {}
}
local isStealing     = false
local stealStartTime = nil
local autoConn       = nil

local function isMyPlotByName(plotName)
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    local plot  = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(plotName)
    if not plot then return false end
    local sign    = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
    local yourBase= sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
    return yourBase and yourBase:IsA("BillboardGui") and yourBase.Enabled == true or false
end

local function findNearestPrompt()
    local char = LP.Character
    local root = char and (
        char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    )
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if not root or not plots then return nil end
    local nearest, distance = nil, math.huge
    for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
        if plot:IsA("Model") and not isMyPlotByName(plot.Name) then
            local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            if podiums then
                for _, podium in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
                    local base  = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
                    local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                    if spawn then
                        local d = (spawn.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                        if d <= Steal.StealRadius and d < distance then
                            local found
                            local attachment = spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                            local candidates = attachment and attachment:GetChildren() or spawn:GetDescendants()
                            for _, prompt in ipairs(candidates) do
                                if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
                                    and prompt.ActionText
                                    and prompt.ActionText:find("Steal") then
                                    found = prompt
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                            if found then nearest, distance = found, d end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nearest
end

local function executeSteal(prompt)
    if isStealing or not prompt or not prompt.Parent then return end
    if not Steal.Data[prompt] then
        Steal.Data[prompt] = {hold = {}, trigger = {}, ready = true}
        if getconnections then
            pcall(function()
                for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
                    if c.Function then table.insert(Steal.Data[prompt].hold, c.Function) end
                end
                for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
                    if c.Function then table.insert(Steal.Data[prompt].trigger, c.Function) end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    local data = Steal.Data[prompt]
    if not data.ready then return end
    data.ready   = false
    isStealing   = true
    stealStartTime = tick()
    task.spawn(function()
        for _, fn in ipairs(data.hold) do pcall(fn, prompt) end
        task.wait(Steal.StealDuration)
        pcall(function() if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end end)
        for _, fn in ipairs(data.trigger) do pcall(fn, prompt) end
        task.wait(0.12)
        pcall(function() if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end end)
        for _, fn in ipairs(data.trigger) do pcall(fn, prompt) end
        stealStartTime = nil
        task.wait(0.45)
        isStealing = false
        data.ready = true
    end)
end

local function startAutoSteal()
    if autoConn then return end
    Steal.AutoStealEnabled = true
    autoConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if Steal.AutoStealEnabled and not isStealing then
            local prompt = findNearestPrompt()
            if prompt then executeSteal(prompt) end
        end
    end)
end

local function stopAutoSteal()
    Steal.AutoStealEnabled = false
    if autoConn then autoConn:Disconnect(); autoConn = nil end
end

local function clampPower(v)
    v = tonumber(v)
    if not v then return intensity end
    return math.clamp(math.floor(v), 1000, 150000)
end

local function updatePower()
    intensity = clampPower(PowerBox.Text)
    PowerBox.Text = tostring(intensity)
end

local function resolveEvent()
    local ok, net = pcall(function()
        local pkgs = RS:WaitForChild("Packages", 5)
        return pkgs and pkgs:WaitForChild("Net", 5)
    end)
    if ok and net then
        local kids = net:GetChildren()
        Event = kids[6]
    end
    return Event
end
resolveEvent()

local function paintActivate()
    if lagging then
        StartBtn.Text = "STOP"
        tween(StartBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)}, 0.25)
        tween(StartStroke, {Transparency = 0}, 0.15)
    else
        StartBtn.Text = "START"
        tween(StartBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}, 0.25)
        tween(StartStroke, {Transparency = 0.2}, 0.15)
    end
end

local function startLagging()
    if lagging then return end
    updatePower()
    lagging = true
    paintActivate()
    if not Event then resolveEvent() end
    if not Event then
        warn("[VIOLETTE] Event not found — check Net index")
        return
    end
    local payload = table.create(intensity, function() end)
    lagThread = task.spawn(function()
        while lagging do
            for _ = 1, 3 do
                pcall(function() Event:FireServer(payload) end)
            end
            task.wait(0.01)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopLagging()
    if not lagging then return end
    lagging = false
    if lagThread then pcall(task.cancel, lagThread); lagThread = nil end
    paintActivate()
end

local function toggleLag()
    if clickLock then return end
    clickLock = true
    if lagging then stopLagging() else startLagging() end
    task.delay(0.12, function() clickLock = false end)
end

local function paintWalk()
    if walking then
        WalkBtn.Text = "STOP"
        WalkBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
        WalkBtnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
    else
        WalkBtn.Text = "WALK ON"
        WalkBtn.TextColor3 = TEXT_WHITE
        WalkBtnStroke.Color = ICE_CYAN
    end
end

-- ========================
-- CONFIG SAVE / LOAD
-- ========================
local function saveConfig()
    updatePower()
    pcall(function()
        if writefile then
            writefile(CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({
                Power   = intensity,
                Scale   = uiScale,
                Background = currentBg,
                PX_S = Main.Position.X.Scale, PX_O = Main.Position.X.Offset,
                PY_S = Main.Position.Y.Scale, PY_O = Main.Position.Y.Offset,
            }))
        end
    end)
end

local function loadConfig()
    if not (readfile and isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE)) then return end
    local ok, cfg = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_FILE))
    end)
    if not (ok and type(cfg) == "table") then return end
    if tonumber(cfg.Power) then
        intensity = clampPower(cfg.Power)
        PowerBox.Text = tostring(intensity)
    end
    if tonumber(cfg.Scale) then
        uiScale = math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.Scale), SCALE_MIN, SCALE_MAX)
        MainScale.Scale = uiScale
    end
    if tonumber(cfg.Background) then applyBackground(math.floor(cfg.Background)) end
    if tonumber(cfg.PX_S) and tonumber(cfg.PX_O) and tonumber(cfg.PY_S) and tonumber(cfg.PY_O) then
        Main.Position = UDim2.new(cfg.PX_S, cfg.PX_O, cfg.PY_S, cfg.PY_O)
    end
end

-- ========================
-- CONNECTIONS
-- ========================
minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    intensity = clampPower(intensity - 1000)
    PowerBox.Text = tostring(intensity)
end)

plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    intensity = clampPower(intensity + 1000)
    PowerBox.Text = tostring(intensity)
end)

PowerBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    updatePower()
    saveConfig()
end)

StartBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleLag)

btnL.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    BgMenu.Visible = not BgMenu.Visible
end)

for i, t in ipairs(thumbs) do
    t.btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        applyBackground(i)
        saveConfig()
        BgMenu.Visible = false
    end)
end

WalkBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    walking = not walking
    if walking then
        local studs = tonumber(studsInput.Text) or 8
        local delay = tonumber(delayInput.Text) or 0.1
        walkThread = task.spawn(function()
            while walking do
                local char = LP.Character
                local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hrp and hum then
                    local dir = hum.MoveDirection
                    if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                        pcall(function()
                            hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + dir * studs
                        end)
                    end
                end
                task.wait(delay)
            end
        end)
    else
        if walkThread then pcall(task.cancel, walkThread); walkThread = nil end
    end
    paintWalk()
end)

-- Collapse (min)
minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isCollapsed = not isCollapsed
    if isCollapsed then
        minBtn.Text = "+"
        BgMenu.Visible = false
        setElementsVisible(false)
        StartBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 8)
        StartBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
        StartBtn.TextSize = 14
        local sc = StartBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
        if sc then sc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) else corner(StartBtn, 12) end
        tween(Main, {Size = UDim2.new(0, FULL_W, 0, collapsedH)}, 0.22)
    else
        minBtn.Text = "−"
        StartBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -56)
        StartBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56)
        StartBtn.TextSize = 20
        local sc = StartBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
        if sc then sc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14) else corner(StartBtn, 14) end
        tween(Main, {Size = UDim2.new(0, FULL_W, 0, FULL_H)}, 0.22)
        task.delay(0.15, function()
            setElementsVisible(true)
        end)
    end
end)

local function setScale(v)
    uiScale = math.clamp(math.floor(v * 10 + 0.5) / 10, SCALE_MIN, SCALE_MAX)
    tween(MainScale, {Scale = uiScale}, 0.2)
    saveConfig()
end
ScaleUpBtn.Activated:Connect(function() setScale(uiScale + SCALE_STEP) end)
ScaleDnBtn.Activated:Connect(function() setScale(uiScale - SCALE_STEP) end)

-- Hover feedback (Mayy style)
local function attachHover(b, baseColor)
    baseColor = baseColor or BG_INPUT
    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tween(b, {BackgroundColor3 = BG_HOVER}, 0.12)
    end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tween(b, {BackgroundColor3 = baseColor}, 0.12)
    end)
end
for _, b in ipairs({btnL, minBtn, ScaleUpBtn, ScaleDnBtn}) do
    attachHover(b)
end
StartBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    if not lagging then
        tween(StartBtn, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58)}, 0.12)
    end
end)
StartBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    if not lagging then
        tween(StartBtn, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56)}, 0.12)
    end
end)

-- Drag: works right after execution, from anywhere on the panel (UIScale-aware)
local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
local function beginDrag(input)
    if dragging then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
    dragging  = true
    dragStart = input.Position
    startPos  = Main.Position
    input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End and dragging then
            dragging = false
            saveConfig()
        end
    end)
end
TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(beginDrag)
Main.InputBegan:Connect(beginDrag)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local sc = math.max(MainScale.Scale, 0.01)
        local d = (input.Position - dragStart) / sc
        Main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
        )
    end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

-- Open anim + load
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, FULL_W, 0, 0)
Main.BackgroundTransparency = 1
task.defer(function()
    loadConfig()
    paintActivate()
    paintWalk()
end)
tween(Main, {Size = UDim2.new(0, FULL_W, 0, FULL_H), BackgroundTransparency = 0}, 0.4)
